name: APEX ATHLETIC & FITNESS STUDIO
tagline: High Performance Training, Wellness & Recovery Sanctuary
description: Apex Studio is a cutting-edge athletic training facility offering Olympic weightlifting platforms, functional turf zones, premier recovery suites (infrared sauna and cold plunge pools), and world-class instructor-led classes designed for every fitness stage.

amenities.name: Olympic Lifting Platforms
amenities.description: Eleiko competition barbells, calibrated bumper plates, and dual rubber-cushioned platforms.

amenities.name: Contrast Therapy & Spa
amenities.description: Nordic cedar sauna, infrared therapy rooms, and 45°F plunge baths for rapid cellular recovery.

amenities.name: Functional Turf & Sled Track
amenities.description: 40-yard athletic turf with rogue dog sleds, battle ropes, plyometric boxes, and kettlebell arrays.

amenities.name: Cardio Studio & Wattbikes
amenities.description: Smart Concept2 rowers, ski ergs, curved woodway treadmills, and Wattbike Atom consoles.

amenities.name: Fuel & Cold-Pressed Juice Bar
amenities.description: Organic whey/plant protein shakes, electrolytes, artisan espresso, and pre-workout refreshments.

amenities.name: Executive Locker Suites
amenities.description: Private rain showers, Malin+Goetz luxury bath products, digital lockers, and steam rooms.

trainers.name: Jordan Cruz, CSCS
trainers.bio: Former collegiate strength coach specializing in lifting ergonomics, explosive power, and post-rehab functional strength.

trainers.name: Maya Torres, NASM-CPT
trainers.bio: Known for pulse-raising HIIT programming, kettlebell flow mastery, and metabolic conditioning tailored for all levels.

trainers.name: Chloe Laurent, E-RYT 500
trainers.bio: Combines dynamic flow with restorative somatic breathwork to enhance athletic mobility, joint stability, and mental clarity.

trainers.name: Tyson Vance
trainers.bio: Golden Gloves competitor teaching footwork, defensive head movement, heavy bag combinations, and heart-pounding intervals.

recoverySuites.name: Infrared Sauna Pod
recoverySuites.description: Quiet post-workout recovery session with full-spectrum infrared heat and guided breathing reset.

recoverySuites.name: Cold Plunge Circuit
recoverySuites.description: Recovery-focused immersion with timed intervals to support inflammation management and energy reset.

recoverySuites.name: Massage Chair Recovery
recoverySuites.description: Targeted deep-tissue release for calves, glutes, and upper back before the next training block.

ptPackages.name: Starter PT Pack
ptPackages.description: Ideal for tuning goals, exercise form, and a measurable training baseline.

ptPackages.name: Performance Coaching Pack
ptPackages.description: Progressive performance plan for members building strength, mobility, and consistency.

ptPackages.name: Executive Priority Coaching
ptPackages.description: High-touch training cadence with schedule planning and ongoing accountability.

announcements.title: New Cold Plunge & Recovery Zone Grand Opening
announcements.content: We have upgraded our Finnish sauna with a twin contrast cold plunge tub maintained at a therapeutic 45°F. Complimentary for Platinum and VIP members.

announcements.title: Autumn 6-Week Functional Fitness Challenge
announcements.content: Registration is now open! Measure progress via InBody body composition scan and complete challenges for exclusive Apex apparel.

announcements.title: Studio Holiday Operating Hours Notice
announcements.content: On upcoming holidays, member keycard 24/7 access remains operational for Platinum & VIP. Front desk staffed 8am - 2pm.

rules: Always scan your digital barcode or key fob upon studio entry.
Towels are mandatory on the gym floor; sanitize equipment immediately after every set.
Re-rack all weight plates, dumbbells, and functional equipment to their designated racks.
Closed-toe athletic shoes required at all times (except during Yoga/Pilates classes in Zenith studio).
Chalk is permitted on designated Olympic platforms only; wipe bars clean after deadlifting or snatches.
Guest passes must be registered at the concierge desk prior to gym floor access.
